highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 brings Skia m153 with Linux font-fallback changes and GPU correctness fixes.

breaking.title: Make Linux fallback fonts explicit when needed
breaking.body: FontConfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback, which can select a different face and change glyphs or text metrics. Choose an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.
Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, preventing access to a mutex in freed storage.
Prevents partial glyph updates from reusing evicted atlas locations and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and submission failures internally. Existing managed flush methods remain void.
Updates the bundled renderer to m153. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Cut the release candidate with release-workflow changes only; this bucket adds no consumer-facing API or rendering changes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Introduced Skia m153 and the Linux FontConfig fallback-order change, with native cached-data teardown corrected. The new HarfBuzzSharp package revision still uses native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Package revision 14.2.1.300 does not upgrade the native HarfBuzz 14.2.1 engine.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews Skia m153 with revised Linux font fallback.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: Explicitly select or bundle fonts when deterministic fallback matters. The preview also corrects native cached-data teardown; its new HarfBuzzSharp package revision still uses native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: This release candidate updates release-workflow integration.
v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.body: Its exact shipment contains no additional consumer-facing API or rendering changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 adds GPU upload and atlas corrections after the release candidate.
v4.153.0.body: It improves Ganesh failure propagation and includes Windows HarfBuzz binaries that pass BinSkim BA2007. The managed flush methods remain void.
